description: Full record of one entity from the architecture entity base: building (coordinates, address, architects, period, style, layer, editorial description in French with English translation, housed institutions, Wikidata QID, verification status), cultural institution (type, founding date, website, buildings it occupies with their architects) or architect/practice (dates, Wikidata QID, works). Accepts the id returned by search_baltic_finnish_architecture (e.g. 'lieu/riga-alberta-iela-4', 'person/alvar-aalto') or a Wikidata QID.

id.description: Entity id from search_baltic_finnish_architecture, or a Wikidata QID (e.g. Q1142522)

name: get_architecture_record
